description: Get per-model token usage for a period. DeepInfra REST: GET /payment/usage/tokens.

from.description: Period start (required). Format 'YYYY.MM', or 'current', or 'current(-N)' for N months back, or a unix timestamp in seconds.

to.description: Period end (same format as `from`); defaults to the current period.

name: deepinfra_get_usage_tokens
title: Get token usage
